Author: GearKeeper
Name: GearKeeper
Description: Leveling gear coverage, protection lists, and inventory moves.
Punchline: See which gear can help your other jobs level.
Changelog:
- Build and publish the Dalamud feed automatically after merges to `main`.

- Include Glamour Dresser gear in dungeon projections, level-100 sets, and optional storage replacements. Show where each stored piece needs to be restored from.

- Highlight upgrade targets in a blocked dungeon’s gearset and show the projected item level after those upgrades.

- Score level-scaling gear such as Halone’s Earring at the checkpoint’s effective item level and display that value in loadout details.

- Group **Level 100 sets** by armor family. List shared armor and accessories once per family and show weapons and shields by job.

- Open the projected dungeon gearset from each blocking point in Overview. See item levels, equip levels, locations, and empty slots.

- Show locked and limited combat jobs in **Level 100 sets** with their status, and omit unnamed placeholder rows.

- Build the best owned level-100 loadout for every available combat job. Browse the full roster under **Level 100 sets**. Prefer the Armoire for eligible pieces reserved for level 100 and use the focus list for dungeon planning.

- Wait for the Glamour Dresser to refresh between deposits and report why a batch stops. Armoury Chest moves are blocked while the dresser is open.

- Store eligible surplus from bags in the Glamour Dresser from **Surplus → Glamour**. The button shows the prism cost.

- Show why each piece under **Surplus → Armoire** is blocked from automatic storage. Fully repaired gear above 100% condition can now qualify. Spiritbond shows a warning by default. Enable **Exclude items with spiritbond** to skip those pieces.

- Use **Store from bags** to deposit eligible, unmodified surplus gear while the in-game Armoire storage window is open.
- Browse Surplus under **Armoire**, **Glamour**, and **Other**. Use **Store from bags** directly from the Armoire group.

- Give Storage horizontal views, readable gear tables, and one selected-item detail pane. Narrow windows use a location picker.

- Storage now shows pending moves by location, with a separate list of verified surplus gear and an explicit Armoire retrieval queue.
- Make Overview easier to scan and add spacing to the priority-job picker. Level 100 jobs are disabled.
- Selecting or deselecting Scholar or Summoner does the same for the other job when both are available.
- Choose priority jobs per character in **Overview → Edit priority jobs**. The picker lists combat jobs by role with their current levels.
- Refresh the in-game UI with a dark blue palette, highlighted tabs, and a two-column job picker with aligned levels.
- Overview shows each priority job’s first AutoDuty item-level or weapon blocker, including known Armoire gear and pieces to retrieve along the way.
- Storage previews eligible Armoury gear for non-priority jobs. Duties without an item-level requirement no longer have an artificial per-slot floor.
